releases.displayName: New Update brings Console Crossplay to MX vs ATV Legends

items.text: Console Crossplay has finally arrived in MX vs ATV Legends. When joining online playlists, all console players will be mixed and matched. Private Squad Compounds will function largely the same, but with Squad Codes now able to bring both XBOX and PlayStation players into your Squad. We have held back PC integration so that we can perform additional testing and make sure that the feature launch goes smoothly. Don't worry, PC players will also get to enjoy the stacked Crossplay lobbies very soon as well!
Update v5.17 also brings new customization in the form of graphics kits from Primal Graphics Co and Rival Ink, as well as new gear sets and helmets from Fly Racing.
New FMX stunts, Flatliner, Tweak Air, Crack Nac, and the Nine o' Clock Nac have been added to your stunt list.
Your Replay Beta feature is getting an update in the form of a new orbit cam functionality that lets you swing your POV around your rider, giving you the ability to see yourself in a brand new light.

[p align="start"]Additions & Update
Crossplay
Crossplay is here! Jump into playlists the same as usual to automatically matchmake with players across Xbox and PlayStation.

Or jump straight into a Squad across platforms by joining with a Squad Code. The Squad Leader can find the Squad Code in Squad Management. Use that code to join their squad by selecting Join Squad in the Online menu.
PC will be joining crossplay soon. Further testing and validation are required before PC can join the console platforms.
Customization
Strap in and prepare for takeoff with new gear from Fly Racing! New helmet designs for Formula S Carbon: Abyss, Zen, Protocol, and Byte!
And Kinetic Mutant squirms its way into the Locker.
New bike graphics just dropped! Rip off that old kit and slap on Primal Graphics FIRE for 2026 Honda or Rival Ink Rails for 2026 Kawasaki!
Stunts
Hang off the bars with four new insane stunts: Flatliner, Tweak Air, Crack Nac, and Nine o' Clock Nac!
Replay
Take control of the camera during Replay with the new Orbit camera controls. Smoothly move the camera around a rider to line up the perfect shot or watch the race from the most intense angles.
[p align="start"]Fixes & Improvements
Gameplay
Fixed a bug causing all crew interactions to be marked as essential, forcing the player to return to Rawling's Farm after most career events.
Replaced the repeated track in the Triple Clash playlist with the missing track.
UI
Added a lighter border to most UI elements, enhancing contrast and visibility.
Fixed a bug causing the Tuning Profile list to be empty when changing events in the Pro 450F EX class.
Other
Improved the performance of the 3D Pause Menu garage.
[p align="start"]Known Issues
Gameplay
Frame rates exceeding 60 FPS may experience visual errors and inconsistent gameplay behaviors, especially when exceeding 120 FPS.
Shift sounds can still trigger at the incorrect revs. More improvements planned.
AI riders will not appear on Pro 450F EX bikes in mixed events; they will only appear in the Pro 450F EX Only class.

We’ve released another content update for your rider's locker and garage! After hearing your feedback for more goggle options, we recently introduced Scott Goggles to the long list of licensed gear brands in Legends- but we didn't want to stop there. Today's update adds several new pairs to choose from, and you can look forward to another major goggle brand joining the lineup very soon.

The handlebar lineup needed some love too, so we’ve added a handful (get it?) of new options from ODI! You’ll find 8 new sets of bars available across all bikes and quads- 4 of which are fully color-customizable.
Along with these new customization options, we've updated the AI and tuned various other features to enhance the overall gameplay experience.

Head over to the garage for all-new ODI Podium and Podium Flight handlebars! Available for all MX bikes and ATVs. Both bars come in 4 awesome styles: SE, Splatter, Blackout, and Stars and Handlebars.
More Scott goggles are waiting for you in the Locker! Try on 5 new styles for Prospect 2.0 and 2 new styles for Split OTG.

The racing season isn't over yet! Get ready to challenge an all new set of unique and demanding tracks later this fall.

notes.title: This pack includes three 2026 Beta motocross bikes

items.text: 2026 RX 450 4T: An awesome new vehicle pack isn't all v5.09 has in store for you though. We've also added new customization for your vehicles and riders, made some changes to time penalties, new stunts and more.: Additions & Updates: Vehicles: The wait is over… all new 2026 Beta MX bikes are revving into the garage along with exclusive team kits and gear!: The pack includes the RX 250 2T, RX 450 4T, and the RX 350 2T, the first addition to the new 350 class.
Time Penalty
We heard your feedback and made some changes to time penalties. First and foremost, penalties won't be applied if you are reset.
The amount of distance you can drive off-track before being reset has been increased slightly. And you won't be reset when returning to the track too far ahead.
Lastly, the base penalty for track cuts has been reduced to 3 seconds, and the maximum track cut penalty is now 15 seconds.
Customization
Excel wheels are coming to the Garage! Try out the Excel One, Takasago Signature and Takasago A60 wheels on your ride.
Switch up your seat with the all new Ribbed, Non-Ribbed, and RF1 designs from Guts!

Fix infinite load when launching an event in the same location as the replay using the Leaderboard menu.
Motocross World Tour

Replace the duplicate Lawlands Classic with Haven Cove Crawl in the Motocross World Tour series; all tracks are now present.

Race against AMA Pro Motocross star Benny Bloss!

releases.displayName: Switzerland - NEW MX vs ATV Legends content update

items.text: Additions & Updates
DLC Tracks

The globe-trotting action of the Motocross World Tour is coming to a close! The final stop takes us to the Swiss Alps! Take in the sights of this gorgeous mountain valley… then Tear It Up! Rip through open fields and wooded hills crisscrossed with tracks and trails, scramble up the foot of a mountain, and race through a village obsessed with motocross!
Now that the tour has come to an end, the full series is available to race in the Series mode! Online, the playlist now contains each track and a rotating freeride playlist is also available.
Time Penalty
Time-based Penalties are here! Keep racing even when going off-track or cutting a corner. You'll get to maintain your momentum, but time will be added to your lap as a penalty.

Racing off-track will accrue penalty time, while cutting a corner or certain obstacles will apply an additional flat time penalty. All penalty time will be added to your finish time and may cost you positions at the final results. Race clean and you won't need to worry about it.

Time Penalty is available in Quickplay, Time Trial, Series, and Online Custom Events. It won't be rolling out to Playlists just yet. Until we've worked in player feedback, we want it to be an opt-in experience. So get into our Discord and let us know what you think.
Customization
Head to the Garage for new graphics from Throttle Syndicate! Check out Gridline for 2026 Honda and Elevate for 2026 Yamaha.
New parts from ProTaper are available for MX and ATV! Pick up Sport and ACF handlebars alongside Pillow Top and Blister Buster Pillow Top grips. And just for MX bikes, MXT 04 tires.
Tuning 2.0

The latest update to Tuning 2.0 adds the Chassis category, letting you dig deep into handling and control. Change how the bike responds when cornering or going over irregular terrain. Adjust its responsiveness to inputs in the air and on the ground. Even adjust how you engage scrubs and whips.
Reminder: Tuning 2.0 is a work-in-progress for Experimental Classes Only. We plan to continue to add more settings in upcoming patches.

Are you giving it your all but can manage to shave a few more seconds off your leaderboard record? See how the top guys do it by checking out their Leaderboard Replays! Head over to the Leaderboard menu to view record hot laps from every player starting now!

It is important to us that all Season 5 leaderboard records contain a replay, so we have made the tough decision to reset the Season 5 leaderboards. Records on “overall” leaderboards will be restored to pre-Season 5 records.

We are dedicated to resolving bugs and ensuring that the Season 5 leaderboards contain valid records. You can now report leaderboard records with bugs, exploits, and other issues directly from the leaderboard menu.

Adjustments to Pro 450F EX this patch are focused on turning and leaning. Tire collision shapes have been adjusted to a more realistic shape and may feel a little different, particularly when cornering or scrubbing.

Power Slide assists have been disabled, putting more of the cornering under your control. This will reduce arcade feeling of slides, and the sensation of under-steering when attempting to assert control.

Want more variety at the starting gate? You can now create up to 32 BRAAP Profiles and Rider Presets. And you can duplicate existing BRAAP profiles to quickly create a whole race team.
We're starting off the new year with some hot new gear from Fox MX26 Racewear collection.
Check out Limited Edition Flexair gear sets Image Phantom and Vision, both with matching V3 RS helmets, Instinct boots, and Vue goggles.
Fox and Honolulu Pawnshop collab gear set with matching V3 RS helmet.
And fan favorite, 180 DNGR! Also available in a Star Racing Yamaha team variant for owners of Yamaha 2025 OEM DLC.
AI

AI collision avoidance has been significantly improved, including AI-to-AI avoidance. Initially, AI attempts to steer away when in close proximity to another vehicle, including when ahead of an oncoming vehicle. When in very close proximity (or a collision), an AI approaching from behind will also actively attempt to brake and disengage.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227142/816af4cddf8c4862088934d242444c9dfa6a2978.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227142/fa7e7c291d84c8eb09963c18302a4a01f14c55dd.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227142/277b9477353569bd2970ace8c73890cdc4d16de6.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227142/c764fbc301ee601acec002dfd33ce0e04b1b1e79.jpg"][p align="start"]Fixes & Improvements
Pastranaland
Trackside branding has been updated with more Travis Pastrana sponsors.
The reset time of trackside tractor tires and tire stacks has been reduced to prevent annoyance and potential griefing.
Track bounds on Invitational events have been adjusted to more accurately reflect the track surface.
Under-story foliage draw distances have been increased to reduce pop-in. Further improvements and optimizations are still in progress.
Online
A server ping indicator has been added to the Online HUD to help communicate when connection issues are occurring. Visibility of the HUD element is controlled by the Player Log HUD settings.
Supercross Expert playlist has been correctly configured with timed races.
[p align="start"]Known Issues
Gameplay
Frame rates exceeding 60 FPS may experience visual errors and inconsistent gameplay behaviors, especially when exceeding 120 FPS.
Shift sounds can still trigger at the incorrect revs. These issues are currently being addressed. More news to come as work progresses.
Fixes & Improvements
BRAAP
BRAAP AI are now using the correct AI Profiles and drive like pro riders instead of goon riders.
BRAAP Riders no longer periodically disappear from a Series as events progress.
BRAAP Riders can appear in the Pastranaland Championship series
Tuning 2.0
Resolved an issue causing the (Tuning 2.0) Stock Tuning Profile to be duplicated during Exhibition event construction.

releases.displayName: BIG NEW feature added in MX vs ATV Legends Update

items.text: Additions & Updates
2025 Compound
This year's Compound Pack is sending you to action sports heaven… Welcome to Pastranaland!
Tear up wild tracks, race through wooded trails, hit iconic spots, and get big air everywhere!
B.R.A.A.P. (Build Rider And AI Profiles)
BRAAP is back! This system allows players to create and customize the AI Riders and their Vehicles then compete against them in any event!

Create up to 16 custom AI Riders with unique appearances, personalities, and vehicles for every class. Build your riders from scratch or from Presets. Control which classes the riders race in by assigning them those vehicles.
Rider Customization
Check out this blast from the past! O'Neal Hardwear Roncada '01 jersey, pants, and gloves! Pair them with new and custom color Sidi Atojo boots and make 2001 Stephane Roncada your first BRAAP Rider.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227142/a45c7c88d3a7e44decb4ba13f1c45cd7e1a4ebc6.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227142/9afa82289f6f63143b2a418afb64637e2355e606.jpg"]
[p align="start"]Fixes & Improvements
Rider Customization
Cleaned out the closet and found a few pieces of unreleased gear. Fly Racing Lite 2025 and FXR Clutch Pro 2024 gear and gloves are now available in tons of stock and custom colors.
Gameplay
Fixed an issue which would cause a few riders to fall from the sky and be wrecked behind the start gate during gate selection in Supercross World Tour.
Most playlists are now using the Timed Race format and have Gate Selection enabled.
UI
Added headers to Preset lists for clarity and presentation.
Corrected swapped Big Horn national track path images.
Animation
Minor stunt animation clean-up and timing adjustments to smooth transitions.
[p align="start"]Known Issues
Gameplay
Frame rates exceeding 60 FPS may experience visual errors and inconsistent gameplay behaviors, especially when exceeding 120 FPS.
Shift sounds can still trigger at the incorrect revs. These issues are currently being addressed. More news to come as work progresses.
Additions & Updates
Vehicle Presets

With so many graphic kits, grips, seats, bars, and other parts to choose from, how can we expect you to settle on just one look? Pop in the Vehicle Presets menu to save up to 16 unique part and color presets for each vehicle. Preview, equip, and update each preset with no hassle.
The Color option in the Garage is now inside Part Selection to make it closer to parts customization and presets.
Rider Customization
Head to the Locker for new riding gear from O'Neal, all with custom color variants and matching gloves. Start with new 2025 designs for Element Racewear, Mayhem Scarz, Hardwear Flow, or Slam.
Then check out updated versions of classic designs: Element Attack, Element Villain, Element Rancid, and Mayhem Crank!
Owners of the 2025 Honda or Yamaha vehicle packs will also get access to race team variants of Slam and Element Rancid.
Vehicle Customization
Get ready for elegant and rugged new equipment from SKDA! For all MX bikes, waxed canvas barpad covers and pleated seats, and custom color Laces seats.
Exclusive to 2025 Husqvarna MX bikes, the Wolves graphic kit.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227142/07f75f9c889a744783c211e16e17c78a7b5566f3.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227142/92334633c8c3f5cdd48d34c7c405d77b74377320.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227142/3531e0844b6d69b9b5b4579597eb0a6276beda3f.jpg"]
Fixes & Improvements
Pitbike Physics

The jitter experienced on pit bikes should now be resolved. This issue was most visible at framerate extremes. The issue was resolved by slightly increasing mass of the bikes and the distribution of that mass. To compensate, both bikes' power output were slightly increased.
Tuning 2.0
You can now reset an entire category of Tuning settings to its default values.
Tuning sliders now display a pip at default value, so you can see how far each setting is from the starting value.
Gameplay

Easy AI just got a little easier. On Base Game tracks, Rookie and Amateur difficulty AI will move at slightly lower speeds and get back up to speed in a more controlled manner. This also has the effect of reducing rider-rider collisions, especially in corners and tough obstacles. And they will tend to take less risky rhythms and generate more errors when they try.
Terrain deformation degeneration/reset in Pro Motocross 2025 tracks during long races no longer occurs.
DLC
Redline Ridge Quarry will be entering the rotation of freeride playlists online.
The starting gate and over-under bridge on Redline Las Vegas Final have been adjusted to improve collision fidelity and resolve issues when driving over the center of the structures.
Redline Las Vegas Final and Bedrock Brawl track boundaries have been adjusted to better reflect the track surface and reduce unnecessary resets.
UI
Minor naming issues and inconsistencies across parts, gear, and tracks are resolved.
The RC Goat Farm badge appears on all Goat Farm tracks.
Leaderboard entries for Redlinering, Slayride, and Axell Breaker and are now being recorded correctly (again).
[p align="start"]Known Issues
Gameplay
Frame rates exceeding 60 FPS may experience visual errors and inconsistent gameplay behaviors, especially when exceeding 120 FPS.
Shift sounds can still trigger at the incorrect revs. These issues are currently being addressed. More news to come as work progresses.
Check out the v4.15 patch notes below!
Additions & Updates
DLC
Welcome to the Redline Ridge Finals! Push yourself and your machine to the limits on four intense race courses to take home the crown!
The finals kick off in the Redline Ridge Quarry where you'll battle up hills and over the water in a new unique Quarry Supercross and maneuver through treacherous terrain on a colossal Enduro.
Things move over to Las Vegas for a two-part finale! Ascend into the crowd, rail enormous berms outside the stadium, and kick up some roost as you tear through the dirt in non-stop high-speed action.
And when it's all over hit-up a giant indoor-outdoor Freestyle in Las Vegas or catch big air thrills in FMX and Waypoint at the quarry.
Customization
Head to the Garage to check out new equipment from UFO Plast! Pair Claw or Arches hand guards with Trax or Axiom grips.
Then hop on an ATV to bolt on new Armat Beadlock Billet wheels and Armor M2 or R2 bumpers by Alba Racing!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227142/29aa434c31235d5db8b0b8e55e17f7f553e5dc98.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227142/7ea10b56db038a212dbf4c3b13e4aa549c64a401.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227142/ff4bee557bbbbccd0f622228e4becfa0be9ab260.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227142/6b7eb4ae63b5a8eca042b2606785f3dbaecfc8fe.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227142/d79a37fb716b07b0608f374c7ab2316e0c8517e3.png"]
[p align="start"]Fixes & Improvements
Tuning 2.0
You can now reset each individual setting to its default value at the touch of a button.
Gameplay
Potential issues when changing equipment or tuning profiles during Time Trial have been resolved.
Reset behaviors in Freeride when using Custom Reset Markers have been cleaned-up to resolve possible bad reset positions.
[p align="start"]Known Issues
Gameplay
Frame rates exceeding 60 FPS may experience visual errors and inconsistent gameplay behaviors, especially when exceeding 120 FPS.
Shift sounds can still trigger at the incorrect revs. These issues are currently being addressed. More news to come as work progresses.

With the end of 2025 Pro Motocross release schedule finished, we have stepped into a very busy part of our road map for Legends Season 4, which will see new tracks, and customization as well as the release of lots of features that we've been working on in the background. In a few weeks, two new environments will release in the Redline Ridge Finals DLC pack, but today we're stoked to add two brand new features to the game: Gear Presets, and Tuning 2.0.

Tuning 2.0 - The roll out for the new tuning system will take place in increments over the course of a few updates. With tuning having such a large effect on the gameplay meta, it would be disastrous if we had to have to roll the feature back after it's release. This will allow us to make sure that the tuning values for each category is perfect before we move on to the next. For this update, the new Tuning 2.0 feature will only be available on the Experimental bike class, with Suspension and Gearing categories available for tweaking. Feedback will be VERY important to us, so make sure you jump into our Discord, and let the Rainbow Studios team know what you like and want to see changed in this new feature.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227142/eab24f04a42e90adb36122a3e1fcd7f75be36e42.jpg"]

Rider Presets - This is a quality of life improvement that you've been requesting for a long time, that will let you save your favorite rider gear sets so that you don't have to build them out from head to toe every single time you want to use them. Hopefully this will help you organize that messy locker. Once we've been able to gather some feedback on the system, we may bring this over to the Garage as well, so make sure to let us know if that's something you want to see rolled out.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227142/03a51e98ec235ae1b0c514c24314c1730889c27e.jpg"]
Additions & Updates
Rider Presets

Looking to try on something new to wear in the Locker, but don't want to lose your current setup? Pop into the new Rider Presets menu to save up to 16 of your favorite looks. Each preset stores a unique set of gear, colors, appearance, name, and number.
Vehicle Tuning 2.0
Hop onto a Pro Physics MX 450F to test out Gearing and Suspension settings in a completely new, more detailed Tuning system.
Create multiple tuning profiles for use in any environment or event type using detailed real-world physics parameters.
Tuning 2.0 is a work-in-progress for Experimental Classes Only. We plan to add more settings and more data visualization over the upcoming patches.
ATV Customization
ATV customization support continues! Check out classic Factory Effex Evo kits for Kawasaki, Suzuki, and Honda.
Also get new ATV kits from Primal Graphics! Washington for Yamaha and Living Color for Kawasaki.
And settle into QuadTech Super Grip seats for all base game and OEM DLC ATVs.
Rider Customization
Head to the Locker for new Cafe and Tidal gear sets from Canvas MX!
Or if you're looking for something fun, pull on Painter or Overalls. Just in time for Halloween!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227142/1818d565f9a786c39a06fe726d0f2878761a1677.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227142/0dbfbac8112ff6e0706be127209fa81dad199ccf.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227142/bef71d1fe2600e7b608ca39b670c38c0cb4c236f.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227142/8c04d1d6f12a5b08b488603cec2035881086f246.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227142/11f7b4013caf50a284705df46abacc24663d0538.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227142/1b2d13bd82a2a204df7e37feecf0de784ee5bb8c.jpg"]
Fixes & Improvements
Gameplay
Deformation fidelity is improved across all 2025 Pro Motocross tracks.
UI
A large amount of menu text is changed from all upper-case lettering to mixed-case lettering.
Known Issues
Gameplay
Frame rates exceeding 60 FPS may experience visual errors and inconsistent gameplay behaviors, especially when exceeding 120 FPS.
Shift sounds can still trigger at the incorrect revs. These issues are currently being addressed. More news to come as work progresses.
Rider and Vehicle Customization may still be reset to defaults upon restarting the game under yet unknown conditions.
If you experience this issue, please immediately Submit a Player Report from the Services menu in Settings, record the Report ID then drop us a line on Discord.gg/MXvsATV
2025 Spring Creek National is missing its funnel track segment.

This causes all riders to get reset to the Fly gate at the start of the race and for rider positions to be “unknown” during the race. The race otherwise proceeds normally. The AI don't behave appropriately and can become stuck. A fix has been prepared and will be released in the next patch.
Tuning 2.0 save data has a bug that will cause it to grow in size until it cannot be loaded. This may cause crashes or trigger errors.
A fix is in test and will be released as soon as possible.

The v4.10 comes packed with two new Pro Motocross Championship tracks, lots of new fixes and improvements, like a lower probability of rain or snow in online lobbies, as well additions to customization like new gear from the Thor MX26 collection, patriotic graphics kits for the bikes, new kits for ATV's from the guys over at the ATV Big Air Tour, new color options for Yoshimura RS-12's, and plenty more.
The 2025 OEM Vehicle Pack DLC will see a major change in the form of bonus vehicles being added to the pack:
Honda: 2007 CR125R, and CR250R bikes, and 2014 TRX 450R ATV
Kawasaki: 2014 KFX450R ATV and 2020 Teryx KRX 1000 UTV
KTM: 2009 450 SX ATV
Suzuki: 2009 LT-R450 ATV
Yamaha: 2018 YFZ450R and YFZ450R SE ATV's and 2018 YXZ 1000R and YXZ 1000R SE UTV's

[p align="start"]Additions & Updates
2025 Pro Motocross
2025 Pro Motocross releases are coming to a close. Ironman and Unadilla are available now! The Budds Creek finale will release next week Tuesday.
Each track releases with new or updated bonus events, including: Ironman Invitational, Unadilla Pit Bike, Budds Creek SX, and Thunder Valley Waypoint.
Vehicle Customization
By popular request… race team graphic kits featured at 2025 RedBud are now available for Triumph and Yamaha!
Yoshimura RS-12 exhausts now available in custom color for all four-stroke MX bikes and ATVs.
2024/2025 Triumph bikes also get access to Tsunami graphics by Rival Ink.
And Throttle Syndicate 3 Rib seats are now also available for all base game and 2025 MX bikes.
More customization for all ATVs courtesy of Alba Racing! Armat Beadlock wheels come in bare metal and coated variants, see how they look with or withoutmud plugs.
Then get fitted with the Armat Sport 3 or Intimidator bumpers, also in bare metal and coated variants.
Check out new kits from our friends at ATV Big Air Tour! Derek Guetter and John Langaas graphic have been adapted for the Rainbow ATV and all OEM ATVs.
Rider Customization
Head to the Locker to check out four of our favorite sets from Thor's MX-26 collection!
On first is Sportmode League in 3 stock and custom color variants. Send it out of the park with the Reflex Sport Rogue helmet.
Sportmode Synth is up next available in blue, white, black, red, custom color styles. Pair it with Fleet Storm helmet and Activate Patriot goggles for maximum RedBud appeal!
Get ready for the gatedrop with Launchmode Futura! And look forward to completing the fit with matching Launchmode gloves, Activate Flite goggles, and Fleet Forge helmet.
Best for last is Launchmode Bleach in camo, acid, aqua, orchid and custom color. This rad kit has matching gloves and looks excellent with the Fleet Blackout and Whiteout helmets.
DLC
Owners of 2025 OEM Vehicle Pack DLCs also gain access to the “bonus” vehicles included in previous years' releases.
Honda: 2007 CR125R and CR250R MX bikes, and 2014 Honda TRX 450R ATV
Kawasaki: 2014 KFX450R ATV and 2020 Teryx KRX 1000 UTV
KTM: 2009 450 SX ATV
Suzuki: 2009 LT-R450 ATV
Yamaha: 2018 YFZ450R and YFZ450R SE ATVs, and 2018 YXZ 1000R and YXZ 1000R SE UTVs
[p align="start"]
Fixes & Improvements
Online

The probability of Rain and Snow weather has been reduced to ZERO during online playlists. This temporary measure is in response to reports of players leaving playlists when encountering adverse weather conditions. This decision was made after some deliberation; ultimately, we felt that keeping lobbies full is important. We plan to collect data from this period onward to make a more informed decision in the future. Let us know what you're seeing on Discord.gg/MXvsATV.
Gameplay
The 2025 Pro Motocross will become available in Series mode upon the release of 2025 Budds Creek.
The Event Settings option Conditions (weather/lighting) has its settings retained when returning from gameplay or other menus.
Customization
The 2025 Red Bull KTM graphic kit is updated to use all official race team sponsor logos.
The ’24 Monster Energy Star Yamaha USA graphic kit is now available for 2023/2024 Yamaha MX bikes.
Improved fitment of goggle straps to goggles and helmets, particularly for Fox Main goggles.
Animation
Improved hand and body position during stunt animations: Cordova, Rock Solid, Double Can, and Lazy Boy.
Fixed minor foot skating and pelvis popping in menu idle animations.
Also cleaned-up transition animations in Locker categories.
Significantly reduced in-air mobility during the Bike Flip stunt to prevent the animation from wigging out during rotations.
[p align="start"]Known Issues
Gameplay

Shift sounds can still trigger at the incorrect revs. These issues are currently being addressed. More news to come as work progresses.

Rider and Vehicle Customization may still be reset to defaults upon restarting the game under yet unknown conditions. If you experience this issue, please immediately Submit a Player Report from the Services menu in Settings, record the Report ID then drop us a line on Discord.gg/MXvsATV.
Additions & Updates
Tracks
2025 Pro Motocross releases continue with Southwick and RedBud, then one week later Loretta Lynn's, then in the following week Spring Creek and Washougal!
Each track releases with new or updated bonus events, including: Southwick Waypoint, RedBud Pit Bike 2, Loretta Lynn's FMX, Spring Creek Invitational, and Washougal Waypoint.
Vehicle Customization
Make your way to the Garage to outfit your 2025 Yamaha MX bikes and ATVs with Fire Series kits by Primal Graphics.
Or change up your look with custom color matte graphic kits for all OEM ATVs and the Rainbow ATV.
When you're done, roll out with new Talon Carbon wheels and Radialite sprocket.
Rider Customization
Head to the Locker to check out six of our favorite sets from the Fox MX26 Racewear Collection!
First up is Flexair Fracture in four stock and custom colors. Complete the look with the V3 RS Fracture helmet and Vue Core goggles.
On second is Flexair Inning with matching V3 RS Inning helmet and Vue Future Inning Vivid goggles.
Stand out from the pack in 180 Image Cosmo! Pair this jersey, pants, and gloves combo with the V1 Image Cosmo helmet and Main Image Cosmo goggles.
Take what's yours in 180 Collect! Pick from four striking color schemes on this full gear set with matching V1 Collect helmet and Main Collect goggles.
180 Kairos is up next! This killer gear set comes in three stock and custom styles and features matching V1 Kairos helmet and Main Kairos goggles.
And finally, the 360 Tine jersey and pants comes in three slick color schemes with paired V3 Tine helmets and Airspace Tine goggles.

\ Accessing the Players list and Squad Management menus should be speedier after removing redundant online permissions checks.

Resolved a related issue which could cause checkpoints to get skipped in the HUD during Trails events, especially at the first checkpoint.

Adjusted 2025 Hangtown track bounds to better fit the track markers in a few sections.
2025 Thunder Valley now uses the correct start position and track bounds during Time Trial.
2025 High Point Pit Bike now posts leaderboard times during Time Trial.

The Rider in the Locker is a little more lively and wants you to check out what they're wearing. Player Names in the Leaderboard menu now support all required characters again.

releases.displayName: MX vs ATV Legends HOT FIX Patch

items.text: Fixes & Improvements

Resolved underlying issues which prevented some players from being unable to access specific DLC vehicles, most notably OEM ATVs and UTVs. Current and previous owners of the 2022 Vehicle Packs, 2023 Vehicle Packs, or Icon Pack should now have full access to all included vehicles. We offer our sincerest apologies to anyone affected, and our thanks for your patience while we worked to resolve the issues.

As a result of the DLC fix, players should no longer experience customization resets on DLC vehicles when restarting the game. If gear and vehicle customization resets persist, please contact us on the MX vs ATV Discord and send a Player Report.
Reduced minimum lap times on shorter 2025 Pro Motocross bonus tracks to correct lap tracking issues and leaderboard times failing to post.
Fixed a bug causing Series difficulty to always use the Indies (Medium) difficulty, regardless of selection.

Our first big addition to ATV customization is finally here! New graphics kits from SKDA and SSI Decals. New parts and parts categories, from new bumpers and suspension, all the way to nerf bars! We already have a lot more parts planned for the next few patches, so make sure to join us on our official Discord server, to let us know what ATV customization you still want to see added!
ATVs may have been the focus, but we thought everyone's locker could use some new rider gear, so we tossed in fresh pieces from Troy Lee Designs, Thor, Seven, and FXR.

We have added a new Experimental playlist, for the Pro Physics 450F so that we can observe how the new bike physics compete with each other. The playlist will rotate weekly between 2025 Supercross, 2025 Pro Motocross, base game Supercross, and base game Nationals. If you have any requests for new tracks to be added to the rotation, hit us up on Discord.
Additions & Updates
Tracks
2025 Pro Motocross is coming soon! Over the the coming weeks we'll see all 11 tracks plus Loretta Lynn's, and 18 bonus events.
Releases start with Fox Raceway and Hangtown, then two weeks later, Thunder Valley and High Point!
Along with bonus events: Fox Raceway Vet National and Pit Bike tracks (updated for 2025), Fox Raceway Waypoints, and a new High Point Pit Bike track.
ATV Customization
The ATV Customization update is here with new parts in nearly every category, and even more categories to modify!
Graphic Kits
Suzuki
SKDA: Divide, Grit, Smoke, Worx
Honda
SKDA: Bomber, Raceway, All Time, GP
KTM

Kawasaki

Yamaha

Rainbow

Settle into new custom color seats for all ATVs: Throttle Syndicate 3 Rib, Thrill Seekers Ribbed, and a custom gripper!
Protect yourself with all new Nerf Bars from Alba Racing and Heel Guards from HMF! Or take them off and run around with just the foot pegs.
Elka Stage and Legacy suspensions have also been added for all ATVs!
Swap out your tired old stock bumper for HMF MX or XC Bumpers! Available in raw metal and coated custom color.
Roll out of the Garage on new SS Alloy Wheels and Mud Lite Tires from ITP! Available for ATVs and UTVs.
Rider Gear
New gear makes its way to the locker! By popular demand: Thor Sportmode Flite! Available in three stock and custom styles. And in RedBull KTM race team for owners of the 2025 KTM DLC.
Or try on TLD SE Pro Array in red or white, both with color customization.
Maybe the Seven Zero Hijack is more your style. Find it in the locker in black, concrete or cyan.
Or slip into FXR Vapor Air gear in stock and custom styles: Lux, Fusion, Berry, and Nuclear.

The community has continued to give us great feedback on the new experimental physics, so we've shipped some new changes. In the v4.03 update, we lightened up the weight of the bike in the air, but went a little overboard! In this update, we've found a nice middle ground, by making it slightly heavier in the air. You should notice that if you start your whip or scrub properly, you can really get the back out there quickly, but have to work to bring it back. We think the rotations new tempo has a really natural feel - but make sure you let us know what you think! We've also adjusted tire slip and suspension, so that cornering feels more natural, there isn't as much chatter going over bumps, and hill climbs feel more better.

2025 Indianapolis, Birmingham, Seattle, and Foxborough have been packed into this huge update to MX vs ATV Legends, along with tons of other feature updates, bug fixes, and additions to customization.

In the initial Season 4 update, we added the 'Pro MX 450F Experimental' class bike, which will serve as a testing ground for our gameplay and physics team. Our goal with this physics set has been to put testing into the hands of the community so we can get feedback directly from you, then incorporate it into each new iteration until we find the ideal pro physics gameplay. We opened an #experimental-physics channel in Discord, where the devs and players can speak directly about how the bike feels, and have been watching your comments on social media. The level of community participation has completely blown us away, and we are excited about the direction the physics is heading. We heard tons of requests to let you ride your favorite factory bikes with the new physics, so as of v4.03 we have added Pro 450F Experimental variants to all 2025 OEM 450F models. Another piece of feedback was that the bike felt much too heavy in the air, making it difficult to whip and maneuver. While the Experimental physics needs its own unique feel, we recognize that part of what makes Legends base gameplay physics so fun is that the bike has a certain flicky feeling in the air that lets you really toss the bike around. So, to help capture that feeling, we have slightly lessened the weight of the bike and made it a little easier to toss around in the air. Tons more changes will be coming in the next update, so make sure you let us know how you feel about v4.03's changes in our Official MX vs ATV Discord!
Tracks

Pro Experimental Physics
The Pro MX 450F Experimental bike is now a little lighter and easier to maneuver in-air.
The bike is more responsive and less likely to lock-up when braking into turns, and much easier to keep under control when leaning back or in a wheelie.
Preload is now driven entirely by suspension compression forces. Nailing the timing of the release will be critical for making big jumps or keeping on rhythm.
Pro Physics “Experimental” variants are now available for all new 2025 OEM 450F models!

An experimental Pro Physics bike has been added to the vehicle lineup, and we need your feedback!
The Pro MX 450F Experimental bike uses our most advanced physics model to date, providing greater realism and accuracy than ever before.
The bike is a little slower and heavier, requiring more attention to speed when tackling rhythms. It is also much easier to wreck on hard landings, so think twice about that full send.

It also features a more accurate weight distribution to simulate real forces, especially on the ground. Expect more accurate tire-slip under acceleration, more inertia when cornering, and more grip when leaning the bike in ruts and berms.
In air physics will also see a significant change. Quick-scrubs will throw the rear wheel in the opposite direction of the scrub. Both scrubs and quick-scrubs are now more effective at staying low.

The bike also uses a new "Clutch RPM Buildup" feature, replacing the “tap” for clutch boost. Briefly hold the clutch to "build-up" RPMs then release for max power. Utilizing the clutch requires a bit more skill and attention to get the timing just right. When cornering, hold the clutch going into the turn then release when exiting. To set up or recover in a rhythm section, hold the clutch while airborne then release it as soon as you land to build up speed.

Our goal is to make this an ongoing cycle of feedback and iteration, based on how the bike feels in your hands. Find the bike your garage, and let us know your feedback directly, by joining us on Discord

Boxcar Round 1 & 2

items.text: We have pushed a hotfix patch to address an issue reported by users, which affected PC players who run uncapped framerates (especially > 120fps) having major issues with the new elevation mechanic.
Thank you to everyone who helped bring this to our attention, which allowed us to get a fix out quickly.
Welcome to MX vs ATV Legends Season 3! Look forward to new content, more customization, improved features, and so much more!

Implemented changes to rider elevation "lurch" mechanic to disincentivize input spamming. The effectiveness of a lurch is determined by the relative position and velocity of the bike. Additionally, the effectiveness of subsequent lurches are progressively reduced until the bike transitions from air to ground or back. This results in converting the spamming advantage into a timing-based advantage which penalizes triggering too early/late and rewards careful/considered use.

Increased the thresholds for near-wrecks during lateral slides to reduce the occurrences of wrecks and near-wrecks when sliding through a turn or sliding into a rut hookup. Also removed the steering near-wreck penalty triggered by a sliding near-wreck.

Improved whoops physics by maintaining constant pitch torque on the rear tire when leaning back while not in a wheelie. This makes it much easier to keep the front of the bike up when skipping whoops and leaning back.
Fixed a bug which caused excessive forces to be applied when playing at >60fps.
Reduced the distance the rider is thrown from the bike during big wrecks.

Improved the cornering animations by sitting the rider more upright the more the bike leans into a slide, giving the appearance that the rider is counter-steering a power-slide. The Rider will still lean with the bike when not in a sideways slide, like when railing inside ruts.

Added animations for rider elevation lurch. While pushing down, the rider pushes the bike down and will stiffen/extend their legs to get the bike as far down as possible. While pulling up, the rider will pull the bike up into themself until nearly sitting on it.

We're kicking off 2024 with improvements to the consistency of wrecks. We've fixed the looping wreck resets in corner, updated the wreck detection system, increased wreck thresholds, and improved suspension capability.
There are now even more ways to stay low on takeoff. Performing quick scrubs with different leaning and turning timing will change the jump trajectory and how far the rider is leaned over at takeoff.

It is now easier then ever to land a gnarly Scrub or Whip. We've improved the behavior of Airborne Helpers which help the rider return to the upright position when letting go of the steering and leaning controls.
Ready for more? We've added 5 new Expert variants of Supercross tracks just in time for the start of the Supercross season: Denver, St. Louis, Atlanta, Indianapolis, & Las Vegas!

Enjoy a first look at Series mode, a new, quick-paced way to unlock tracks and earn MotoCoin. Compete in a series of scored races, if you come out on top you can win big. Expect more enhancements in future patches!

Adjusted the water obstacles in Lechuga Lakes Nations; raised the terrain slightly to reduce wrecking in what should be shallow puddles.

Added Series mode. In Series, the player competes against a consistent roster of riders over a series of events scored by finish position. Players can earn a big payout at the end of the series based on their final standings. Series is a low-friction alternative to Career, allowing players to quickly unlock tracks by playing through each series.

Updated the Wreck evaluation system to improve the detection and triggering of wrecks.

Added Quick Scrub variations based when leaning and turning are applied before jump take-off. Each type of Quick Scrub changes the jump trajectory and how far the rider is leaned over at takeoff. For a Regular Quick Scrub push lean and steer in opposite directions at the same time. For an Upright Quick Scrub steer into the jump before leaning in the opposite direction. For a Leaned-Over Quick Scrub lean into the jump before turning in the opposite direction.

Increased the strength of the helpers which return the rider to an upright position while airborne. Releasing the lean and turn controls will more quickly return the rider upright, perfect for recovering from big whips or scrubs, and even flips. This assist is disabled when Pro Physics is enabled.
Adjusted frame collision to reduce sticking on low-friction surfaces.
Increased stiffness of ATV suspension to reduce bouncing.
Rider head looks in the direction of the bike movement when in-air.
Fixed various minor animation bugs.
Fixed an issue allowing the rider to fall into the ground when wrecking.
Did you think we were done improving scrubs? Not quite yet! Scrubs are now looser and easier to bring back, safer and more reliable on steep jumps, and even have new animations.
No more AI bullying! Impacts between Players and AI have been reworked to give Players the advantage. Now it's your turn to shove them around!
Say goodbye to weird wrecks in deep ruts! Chassis collision has been revamped to improve interactions with deformed terrain and other obstacles.
ATVs got some much-needed love. They are now heavier, bounce less on hard landings, and have improved suspension.
Button remapping is finally here! Create custom controls by remapping nearly every input in the game.

If you're looking for a challenge before the start of the moto season, look no further than the newly improved Expert Supercross tracks! Deeper whoops and bigger jumps will have you checking your speed and rethinking those rhythms!

Race starts are looking a little more lively with new start gate warm-up animations and attack pose animations. Get yourself into the attack pose by holding the clutch and throttle then leaning forward so you're ready when the gates drop!

Environment: Added Expert variants of 8 base game Supercross tracks, featuring tougher obstacles; deeper whoops, bigger jumps, adjusted rhythm sections, and more. Expect the remaining 9 tracks in a future patch.
Environment: Reworked terrain deformation in all environments for improved accuracy and appearance. Tire ruts are narrower and better fit tire width.
Gameplay: Added Enduro event category with 1 existing track and 1 more track coming soon.

Physics: Adjusted chassis collision to improve interactions with deformed terrain and drivable objects.

Physics: Adjusted scrub (and whip) behaviors based on continued community feedback and to reconcile changes to the chassis collision. Airborne controls are now slightly looser and more responsive. Scrubs can be initiated more reliably on steep jump faces and much sooner before takeoff.
Physics: Fixed a bug which sometimes caused wrecks upon landing after performing a whip or scrub.
Physics: Reduced penalty impact to steering control when triggering a near-wreck with that penalty.
Physics: Adjusted forces required to trigger some near-wreck conditions related to landing and sliding.
Physics: Improved collisions between vehicles, especially MX bikes, and reduced instances of wrecks during minor impacts.

Physics: Reworked vehicle-to-vehicle collisions to give Players an advantage over AI. Player vehicles can now push around AI vehicles more easily. During a collision, AI vehicles are now unlikely to overpower player vehicles or cause them to wreck.

Physics: Increased the mass of the ATV slightly to make it feel more grounded. Adjusted ATV suspension to compensate for adjustments to the mass and chassis collision. ATVs are now heavier and bounce less on hard land landings.
Physics: Increased the influence of forward and backward leaning on suspension. Pitching the rider forward and backwards will now make it easier to keep the front-end up in whoop sections.
Animation: Added three new warm-up animations to riders at the start gate: shoulder hype, shadow boxing, and glove warmer.
Animation: Added attack pose animation to AI riders before the gate drop. Get yourself into the attack pose by holding the clutch and throttle then leaning forward to keep the front wheel down.

Animation: Added unique rider animations to scrubs and quick scrubs to help differentiate them visually. Both animations now start on the face of the jump, have improved rider body position, and are responsive to inputs while airborne.
Animation: Updated some near-wreck animations to appear more natural and better illustrate the cause of the condition.

Animation: Improved cornering animations to help communicate when the bike is losing traction. During the slide, the eider becomes more upright and will start to lose balance right before completely sliding out.
Animation: Fixed over-extended suspension on some MX bikes when viewing bikes in the Garage menus.
Animation: Fixed over-extended suspension on some MX bikes when airborne during gameplay.
Animation: Fixed various minor animation bugs.
Other: Fixed an issue allowing the rider to fall into the ground when wrecking.

Dynamic Weather has arrived! When playing in a rainy weather scenario, the intensity of the rain will build and disperse over time, moving from overcast to light rain to heavy rain and possibly even to a thunderstorm. As the intensity of the rain changes, so will the ground conditions. When the ground is wet, deformation is much more aggressive and new ruts take on a different shape. Traction, friction, and other ground physics are also impacted when riding through muddy terrain.
The weather system is debuting first in 2023 Thunder Valley before appearing in the other 2023 Pro Motocross tracks and then being rolled out to base game environments.
Thunder Valley with dynamic weather unlocks this Thursday, for all owners of the DLC 2023 AMA Pro Motocross Championship.
